descriptionHtml:
AMD Ryzen 5 3600 Gaming Bundle (ASUS PRIME B450M-A II Motherboard / Patriot Viper Steel 16GB 2x8GB DDR4 3200MHz CL16 RAM / Socket AM4 / PCIe 3.0 / Dual Channel Memory Support / 1-Year Store Warranty)

Upgrade or build your mainstream gaming PC with this high-value complete hardware bundle from Turbo Computer Egypt, backed by a 1-Year store warranty. This combo pack includes the reliable AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-core 12-thread desktop processor, paired perfectly with the feature-rich ASUS PRIME B450M-A II AM4 motherboard, and high-performance Patriot Viper Steel 16GB (2x8GB) DDR4 3200MHz CL16 memory kit. Designed for optimal compatibility and multi-tasking stability, this bundle offers an exceptional plug-and-play foundation for budget-to-midrange gaming builds.
